builder.objective: REPAIR V3-06: Wire the sync pipeline into the product: (a) applyDeltas must materialize each pulled record into its business table (or the sync layer must replay the payloads through the ledger/use-cases) inside a transaction, then advance the cursor; (b) every local business write must record its dirty record via storeLocalRecords (or equivalent) so pushDeltas has real payloads; (c) add an end-to-end test proving a remote delta changes business data and a local write is pushed, not just buffer/cursor mechanics.; Add a real invitation flow: an invite action in the group (share sheet with the link), a deep-link route (e.g. /join/:token) that resolves the invitation and accepts it atomically (membership + member), and an honest adapter behind the existing invitation port. Keep the flow free of any plan/entitlement gating.; Add a group-options screen reachable from the group (per constitution §3 'Options restent hors de la navigation principale') exposing: contribution unit Minutes|Points with explicit confirmation that historical entries keep their provenance/unit (no silent conversion), and the compensation toggle + group-defined rate. Wire it to unitChangeService and the household settings.; Enforce tenant isolation and balance integrity in the data-access path (repository or use-case level): every read/write scoped to the caller's memberships, ledger mutations only through append/revision/tombstone, and applyDeltas must use the deterministic revision/timestamp/id conflict resolution instead of blind overwrite. Add hostile tests (cross-tenant read blocked, balance falsification rejected, concurrent same-id edits resolved deterministically).; Add end-to-end sync tests: apply a remote delta and assert the business record is readable and balances are updated; create a local write and assert it appears in getDirtyRecords and is pushed; simulate a conflict and assert the deterministic resolver outcome. These tests must fail until the pipeline is wired.
builder.scope: Repair only the audited must-fix findings on the preserved V3 baseline; do not rebuild accepted work.

storeLocalRecords has callers and getDirtyRecords returns real payloads; pushDeltas sends actual local writes
group-options UI reachable from group settings: unit toggle (Minutes|Points) with provenance warning, compensation toggle + rate
invitation UI: invite action with share sheet, /join/:token deep-link route, atomic acceptance (membership + member)
authorization rules enforced in data-access path: tenant isolation on reads/writes, deterministic conflict resolution replacing blind LWW in applyDeltas
hostile tests: cross-tenant read blocked, balance falsification rejected, concurrent same-id edits resolved deterministically
end-to-end sync tests: remote delta materializes into business data, local write appears in getDirtyRecords and is pushed
